featured.story: Buddies Spa and Big Gay Smiles Dental, two LGBTQIA+ small businesses in Washington, DC, have built a partnership rooted in mutual support and community care. Through cross-promotion and shared values, we help each other grow while building a network of safe, affirming places where people can relax, heal and get the care they deserve.
featured.quote: At Big Gay Smiles, led by Dr. Robert McKernan, we are proud to be an LGBTQ2IA+ owned dental practice in the heart of Washington, DC. We're more than a dental office; we're a community. Through our "10% Promise," 10% of our annual revenue is donated to local and national HIV/AIDS nonprofits.
